user.title: Control4 Yandex Relay
user.description: Connect to the Yandex Relay driver on the Control4 controller. The pairing code is in the driver's properties in Composer. The Home Assistant URL must be reachable from the controller (use the IP address, not a .local name).

data.ha_url: Home Assistant URL for the controller

bind.title: Stations and rooms
bind.description: Pick the Control4 room each Yandex Station streams its music to.

reauth_confirm.title: New pairing code
reauth_confirm.description: The driver on {host} rejected the pairing code (it was probably re-added). Enter the new code from its properties in Composer.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the driver. Check the IP, the port and that Bridge Status is ONLINE.
error.bad_url: The URL must start with http:// or https://.

abort.already_configured: This driver is already set up.
abort.no_stations: No Yandex Stations found. Set up AlexxIT YandexStation first.

init.title: Stations and rooms
init.description: Pick the Control4 room each Yandex Station streams its music to.

abort.invalid_auth: Wrong pairing code: reconfigure the integration.
